datasets.name: Sentinel-1 SAR images
datasets.verbatim: Copernicus Sentinel-1 data have been downloaded from the Copernicus Open Access Hub (https://scihub.copernicus.eu, Copernicus, 2020).

datasets.name: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) 1 s DEM
datasets.verbatim: Consecutive SAR images, selected to detect amplitude changes of the radar signal (i.e., change detection), are co-registered with a digital elevation model (DEM)-assisted procedure that uses the Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) 1 s DEM, auto-downloaded by SNAP.

datasets.name: Optical images (Planet explorer)
datasets.verbatim: Optical images have been downloaded from the Planet explorer application (Planet Team, 2017)...Planet Team: Planet Application Program Interface: In Space for Life on Earth, San Francisco, CA, available at: https://api.planet.com (last access: 24 January 2020), 2017.

methods.name: Automatic processing chain for SAR amplitude change detection
methods.summary: An automatic processing chain implemented in Python and GNU/Bash scripts that performs Sentinel-1 SAR image ingestion, preprocessing (thermal noise removal, calibration, de-bursting, multi-looking, co-registration, speckle filtering), log-ratio change detection, Mean Shift segmentation using GRASS GIS, and statistical identification of landslide-affected areas.

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement present, no shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom processing code is not provided via any repository or persistent link.
